title: Career Roadmap · Mason
summary: A Mason constructs and repairs walls, foundations, floors and other building elements using bricks, blocks, stone, mortar and concrete, following construction drawings and site specifications.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Bricklaying • Blockwork • Mortar mixing • Plastering • Tile and stone work • Concrete work • Construction-site safety.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Complete Class 10; verify the chosen trade's entry requirements.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 can help with technical progression but is not always required for vocational training.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Construction safety, measuring, marking, tools and materials.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Masonry skills
blocks.text: Bricklaying, blockwork, mortar mixing, levelling and plastering.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Concrete work, stone masonry, waterproofing basics, construction drawings and quality checks.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Practical portfolio, supervised site experience, material estimation and apprenticeship applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Build a small brick wall panel • Construct a block corner • Practise plastering on a test surface • Set out a small masonry layout from a drawing.

blocks.text: Mason → Stone Mason / Brickwork Specialist / Finishing Mason.

blocks.label: Supervisory route
blocks.text: Experience + drawing and measurement skills → Masonry Team Leader / Site Supervisor.

blocks.label: Self-employment route
blocks.text: Practical experience → Masonry and small construction-services business, subject to local rules.

blocks.text: Eligible Civil Engineering diploma → Construction technician, site coordination or supervisory roles.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Bricklaying, mortar preparation, levelling, alignment, plastering, material estimation, drawing interpretation and site safety.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Trowels, spirit levels, plumb bobs, measuring tapes, masonry cutters, mixers and basic digital measurement tools.
